SELECT C.DOMAIN_ID , C.COMPANY_CD , C.COMPANY_NM , E.EMAIL , E.EMP_NM , E.EMP_NO , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', '03000', E.POS_CD, E.COMPANY_CD, E.DOMAIN_ID) AS POS_NM , D.DEPT_NM , E.ENTER_DT , E.QUIT_DT , E.JOB_TEL_NO , E.MOBILE_TEL_NO , E.MANUAL_MNG_YN , E.HIDDEN_YN FROM EMP_MASTER E INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER D ON (E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND E.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = D.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (E.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = C.DOMAIN_ID)
E.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND E.EMAIL = #{email}

SELECT E.DOMAIN_ID , E.COMPANY_CD , C.COMPANY_NM , E.EMAIL , E.EMP_NM , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', '03000', E.POS_CD, E.COMPANY_CD, E.DOMAIN_ID) AS POS_NM , D.DEPT_NM , A.AUTHORITY_NAME FROM EMP_MASTER E INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER D ON (E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND E.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = D.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (E.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = C.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN EMP_AUTHORITY A ON (E.COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = A.DOMAIN_ID AND E.EMAIL = A.EMAIL)
E.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND E.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd} AND A.AUTHORITY_NAME = "ROLE_ADMIN"
AND D.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE REPLACE(CONCAT('%', #{empNm}, '%'), ' ','')
AND E.EMAIL LIKE REPLACE(CONCAT('%', #{email}, '%'), ' ','')
ORDER BY DEPT_ORD, DEPT_NM, EMP_NM
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP_MASTER E INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER D ON (E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND E.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = D.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (E.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = C.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN EMP_AUTHORITY A ON (E.COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND E.DOMAIN_ID = A.DOMAIN_ID AND E.EMAIL = A.EMAIL)
E.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND E.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd} AND A.AUTHORITY_NAME = "ROLE_ADMIN"
AND D.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE REPLACE(CONCAT('%', #{empNm}, '%'), ' ','')
AND E.EMAIL LIKE REPLACE(CONCAT('%', #{email}, '%'), ' ','')
ORDER BY DEPT_ORD, DEPT_NM, EMP_NM
